title: Stateful safe AtomicWriteFile non-append analogue
purpose: Retain the issue-relevant FILE record-service structure and statefulness while replacing the historical append trigger with a safe non-append write sequence to the same file object.
expected_behavior: Target accepts two sequential confirmed AtomicWriteFile requests as ordinary record writes to explicit start records, replying with acknowledgments or application errors according to FILE object support and permissions.
constraints_preserved: Each BVLC total length 0x0019 matches the corresponding message size
Confirmed service choice 0x07 preserved for AtomicWriteFile
Two-step stateful sequence targets the same FILE object instance
Explicit start records 0 and 1 are used instead of append sentinel semantics
Payload records are short fixed-length ASCII data for mutation-friendly fuzzing
issue_safety_notes: Exact append-collision semantics from the historical issue are removed: no fileStartRecord=-1, no repeated append path, and no intentionally malformed record-count interactions.
